signals.name: Three-month price momentum
signals.why: Accelerating falls usually mean more to come; two months under -0.5% is the first sign of a floor.
signals.against: One month is noise; Cotality revises recent months (Sep went from -1.2% to -2.1%).
signals.material: Yes if it flips to stabilising: the waiting case weakens.

signals.name: RBA cash rate
signals.what: Cash rate 4.85% after the 3 Nov hike; next decision 8 Dec 2026.
signals.why: Serviceability caps what buyers can pay; each 0.25pt cuts borrowing power ~2.5%.
signals.against: Statement dropped the tightening bias; three members voted to hold.
signals.material: Yes: changes repayments in Row 8 and the bear/base weighting.

signals.name: Selling time (southern suburbs, REIWA median DOM)
signals.what: Median of suburb median days on market for settled sales.
signals.why: Longer selling times give buyers leverage and often precede discounting.
signals.against: Settled-sale DOM lags the market by 1-3 months.

signals.name: Sales volume (12-month house sales, universe)
signals.what: Sum of REIWA 12-month house sales counts across included suburbs.
signals.why: Falling turnover = weak demand; a rebound in volumes is an early recovery signal.
signals.against: 12-month windows move slowly; settlements lag contracts.
signals.material: Watch for a turn upward before prices.

signals.name: Vendor discounting (capitals)
signals.why: Bigger discounts = sellers adjusting to buyers.

signals.name: WA unemployment
signals.why: Job losses turn a correction into forced selling.
signals.material: A rise above 5% would favour the bear path.

news.h: Big four pass on the November hike; no variable rates under 6%
news.p: CBA, Westpac, NAB, ANZ lift variable rates 0.25pt from 13 Nov (6.49-6.59%). Lowest advertised owner-occupier variable 6.14%.

news.h: RBA lifts cash rate to 4.85% (6-3 vote)
news.p: Fifth hike of 2026; tightening bias dropped. Next meeting 8 Dec.

news.h: Cotality: Perth -1.7% in October, -5.7% over the quarter
news.p: Perth 8.9% below April 2026 peak; capital-city days on market 39, discounting 4.7%.
